expected_findings.behavior: The profile cache key no longer includes the tenant even though user IDs are only unique inside one tenant.
expected_findings.impact: A profile cached for one tenant can be returned to a user with the same local ID in another tenant, disclosing cross-tenant data.
evidence: The project contract states that user IDs are tenant-local and every data lookup must retain tenant scope.
The changed cache key and its caller now use only userID.
The cache test exercises only one tenant and cannot detect a collision.
